selection: all eight existing n=5000 rank-native cases; do not select by recovery or instability
paired_measurement_policy: do not rerun the monotone-transformed copies: the previous completed study verified identical local scores and exact targets
pairing: same candidate table, exact target and seed namespace across budgets; seed index is not an independent dataset
interpretation: Compare the combined increase in particles and MH moves, not their isolated effects. No score/prior/model changes, data regeneration, speedup study, automatic winner selection or metadata-study launch.
